explanation: C3, C4, and CAM photosynthetic pathways each present specific ecological advantages and disadvantages depending on local climatic conditions. C4 plants are highly adapted to environments with high light intensities, high temperatures, and limited rainfall. C3 plants perform better under cool temperatures (below 25°C) and high moisture. CAM plants are uniquely adapted to extreme aridity. CAM photosynthesis occurs in 23 families of flowering plants, as well as in some nonflowering plants.
